codes.description: The same entity id appears on two entities of the document.
A key is repeated in its scope: entity keys in the plan, check keys per owner, batch keys per phase, section ids per entity, option keys per decision, material keys.
An item key does not start with its phase key, or a unit key does not start with the key of an existing item.
An entity id was published before with another kind (plan_entity_identities).
An entity depends on, relates to, supersedes or parents itself.

A reference names a key that does not exist in the document (depends_on, relations, decisions, implements, owners, applies_to, supersedes, batch items, unit checks, criterion checks, unit parent, read refs to entities/materials/artifacts, review.covers).
An output artifact key is declared by more than one item.
An input artifact cites an output key but names another mount or path.
A plan relation target is not a plan of this project; it is kept unresolved.
The compiled execution graph has a cycle (items, phases, units, batches or a mix); details.cycle lists the task keys.
A batch lists an item of another phase.
An item is listed in more than one batch.
A phase has batches but the item is in none; it is scheduled without a batch barrier.
An item depends (directly or transitively) on an item of a later batch of the same phase; batches run in order, so it would never start.
A mount name is not a repository mount of the project (paths, reads, check cwd, artifacts, materials, forbidden paths).
Two units of the same item without a dependency path between them declare overlapping write scopes.
Tasks of different items without a dependency path have overlapping footprints; the scheduler will not run them in parallel.
A unit write-scope entry is not covered by the change hints of its item.
An item of work kind code, config, test or docs declares no change hints and none of its units declares a write scope.
Change hints or write scopes change code files (planning.validation.code_suffixes) but name no test path.
A change hint or write scope intersects execution_constraints.forbidden_paths.

A detailed phase has no items, or an item of a detailed phase lacks scope.include, an acceptance check (own or via its units) together with any criterion (their links are checked by criterion_unlinked), a deliverable, or any of reads/change_hints/guidance_md/sections.
The phase is a skeleton: publication is allowed, execution readiness will refuse its tasks.
The plan goal or context still equals the title.
research.need is required but no question is written.
A criterion cannot be verified: mode check without checks, mode manual without a manual check, or mode review while the item review is waived.
A criterion check is not owned by the criterion owner, its item or its phase, or its kind does not match the mode (manual check for mode manual, non-manual for mode check).
A must requirement has no implements or owns link.
An item of a detailed phase has no acceptance criteria; acceptance relies on its checks only.
A required review declares neither reviewer nor max_rounds; the run defaults apply.
A unit of kind command has no command, or a command is set on a unit of another kind.
An item check runs a repository-wide command (planning.validation.heavy_check_markers); move it to the phase.
An item check runs the same argv or script as a check of its phase.
A manual check sets rerun_after_integration; a human verdict after integration has no path in the task state machine.
An open decision lacks a question; a proposed or accepted decision lacks decision or rationale; decision names an option key that does not exist.

Supersession is inconsistent: a decision is superseded but nothing supersedes it; a decision supersedes one whose state is not superseded; a decision is superseded by more than one decision; or a decision that supersedes others is not accepted.
A decision or material is both global and bound with applies_to.
An accepted decision or a material is not global, has no applies_to and is read by no entity: it reaches no context.
Two brief messages carry the same text.
A text field (plan context, brief message, section) exceeds planning.validation.heavy_text_kb and enters many contexts.
Rules, pitfalls and guidance of an item exceed planning.validation.heavy_text_kb.
A file_version material does not exist, belongs to another workspace or its bytes are not available.

A must_refresh material is already older than its freshness.max_age_seconds at validation time (file version created_at or retrieved_at; an external source without retrieved_at counts as stale): execution will wait with BLOCKED_BY_MATERIAL at every stage listed in required_for.
A route names a runtime that is not in the runtime catalog.
A route names a model that is not in the catalog of its runtime.
A skill key is not known to the extensions registry for this scope.
